Feature 05

🔔 Unified Alerts & Sensory Settings

Full-screen perimeter flash, alert chime, and haptic vibration for sensory awareness.

When someone speaks, a sudden movement or loud sound is detected, or SOS is triggered, ConnectPlus alerts you with a glowing perimeter flash, tone chime, and haptic feedback.

Feature 06

⚡ Sudden Shake & Loud Noise Detection

Device motion and Web Audio sensors detect distress or sudden sounds. 100% processed locally.

⌨️ Keyboard Shortcuts & Accessibility

Navigate ConnectPlus quickly using these standard accessibility shortcuts:

Alt + MToggle Speech-to-Text Microphone
Alt + BJump to Communication Board
Alt + LJump to Live Captions
Alt + TCycle Themes (Light / Dark / High Contrast)
Alt + SOpen Emergency SOS modal
? (Shift + /)Show this keyboard shortcuts dialog
EscDismiss Open Dialogs and Modals
